notes.title: 5.0.32 Update
notes.content:
We’ve been quietly working behind the scenes to bring you a patch packed with fixes and improvements, and we’re thrilled to finally share it with you!

Thank you for your patience and support as we continue to make the game better.

Enjoy the update!

Patch Changes

Steam Deck: Made game launcher responsive.
Localization: Fixed some English messages.
Graphics: Refactored graphical shaders (Step 1).
Input: Allowed up to 4 gamepads for splitscreen.
Multiplayer: Synchronized grappling hook.
Multiplayer: Fixed leaderboard navigation.
Multiplayer: Fixed mods downloading dialog.
Multiplayer: Fixed crash when muting/unmuting players.
Multiplayer: Fixed some voice chat issues.
Multiplayer: Fixed connectivity issues with modded and ranked sessions.

notes.title: 5.0.30a Update
notes.content:
- Implemented BugSplat crash reporting system. Now it's possible to send us the crash dumps.
- Fixed crash when mods are updated.

notes.title: 5.0.29 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just wanted to take a moment to say thank you for all the support and feedback we received!
We are incredibly grateful to have such an amazing community and we are working hard to make Crash Time: Undercover the best experience possible.

In this update we have addressed several key issues and introduced some important bug fixes:

- Fixed some English subtitles.
- Fixed default XInput mappings.
- Fixed crash when attempting to download mods.
- Fixed corrupted savegame and automatically fix the savegame for older versions.
- Specify which controller will be used after restart.
- Fixed some of the lobbies connection issues.
- Fixed Gerome Cassel looping sample.
- Fixed case unlocking mechanism by using MissionID rather than sequentially. This unlocks the possibility to have case/mission mods that doesn't depends on the stock career progress.

We are working hard to get all critical issues sorted out as quick as possible.

Keep it coming, and we will keep you updated on what's next!

Thank you again and have fun!

notes.title: 5.0.27 Update
notes.content:
